cal-h1-03.note: rejected for mi / no / funciona not listed. Claimed defect: words absent from context.taughtBefore, read as an exhaustive list because the prompt describes taughtBefore as everything the learner has been taught. Not a substantive defect: the curriculum teaches these earlier (docs/CURRICULUM-A1-A2.md line 101 A1-02-L5 possession my/your; line 142 A1-03-L6 negative sentences; line 692 CV-02 muy/mucho staged in A1-02-L4/A1-05-L1; docs/CONTENT-PLAN.md line 17 present inventory includes venir; funcionar is a regular -ar verb, A1-04). The calibration contexts list only task-relevant prerequisites; the prompt wording made them look exhaustive (instrument defect, fixed in prompt v3). Counted as a rejection without substantive support.
